name: Out of Love
detailed_description:
This is a story about "love". In this stealth game, the character you control is a girl who is saved by others and gains hope. For you, hope is all about "love". But you have to face the people who hinder you and protect that hope. Otherwise, you will be trapped in mental difficulties forever. Every choice you make will make them unable to hinder you, and you will gradually realize the existence of the one staring at you in the dark.

Game Features:

· Whether it is covert actions to deal with obstacles or interactions with others, each choice will affect the direction of the ending.

· Your behavior will affect her mental state and ending, and the scene and sound effects will be distorted with her mood.

· Collect scattered mysterious objects on campus and gradually piece together the truth you want to know.

· The unique environmental narrative immerses you in it.

· Uses high-contrast light and shadow with rich colors and very individual artistic expression.

Content Description:

· This game contains abstract psychological horror elements

· Involves symbolic expressions of mental dilemmas.

·Not suitable for people with weak psychological endurance.

·All characters and events are fictional and all contents are fictional creations.

short_description: A story of love, obsession, and the descent into darkness. In this game, love is not always sweet—it can be dangerous, deadly, and utterly consuming.
